implementation.coefficient_exchange: lanes 0..7 construct output-0 scale/min pairs and lanes 8..15 construct output-1 pairs; native-wave shuffles replace 1024 B LDS and all block barriers
implementation.scope: gfx1100 c=1 Laguna attention output and unequal query/gate roles only
implementation.fallback: registered pack8 singleton/pair remains the default and handles rows>1, gfx1151, registry miss, unsupported layout/shape, shared-expert roles, and explicit selector disable
